mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_waiting (wait_id, bno, userid, res_date, priority, status, regdate) VALUES (seq_waiting.NEXTVAL, #{bno}, #{userid}, #{resDate}, #{priority}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT wait_id AS waitId, bno, userid, res_date AS resDate, priority, status, regdate AS regdate FROM tbl_waiting WHERE bno = #{bno} AND res_date = #{resDate} AND status = 'WAIT' ORDER BY priority ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT wait_id AS waitId, bno, userid, res_date AS resDate, priority, status, regdate AS regdate FROM tbl_waiting WHERE userid = #{userid} ORDER BY res_date DESC, priority ASC
